notes.title: --DEFINITIVE UPDATE--
notes.content:
[p]With this, the development of [i][b]Immortal Magus[/b][/i] comes to a close.

[b]FEATURES:[/b]

[list]
[*]bug fixes
[*]added customization options for Skirmish
[*]added new maps for Skirmish
[*]new intro
[*][b]NOTE! Due to how save files work in this game, the old saves are now obsolete.[/b]
[/list]

Thank you for playing Immortal Magus!
